_about: Structural knowledge read off this BLANK form's own text layer: which printed label sits where, whether a label repeats once per nominee column, and where each tick box is. Regexes match the start of a label's first text run on the blank form.
title: CAMS Mutual Fund — Nomination (360 ONE / HDFC)

tickboxes.note: confirmed visually: rendered and cropped nominee 1's relationship block on the 360 ONE filled sample - the printed 'o' glyph in front of "Daughter" has a hand-drawn-style checkmark vector overlaid on it, identical text-wise ("o") to the unmarked options and to the blank form. The text diff found NO difference here at all; only rendering the page as an image showed the mark. This means positions are known (the 'o' glyph's x,y per option per column) but which option is selected cannot be read from text alone - a future filler would need to draw the same kind of mark, not write text.
